data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: allergy
sections.summary: A condition in which the body reacts badly to a particular substance, such as a food, pollen or animal hair, causing symptoms like sneezing, rashes or breathing difficulties.

senses.definition: a medical condition in which the body reacts badly to a particular food, substance or environment
examples: She carries an EpiPen at all times because of her severe allergy to peanuts.

senses.definition: an informal strong dislike or aversion to something
examples: He seems to have an allergy to doing any housework whatsoever.

answers.answer: The restaurant always asks customers about food allergies before taking their order.
She showed great allergy in completing all the medical forms before her hospital appointment.
He felt allergy when the doctor confirmed the results were not as serious as he had feared.
The allergy was very comfortable and the patients were well looked after by all the nursing staff.

sections.question: diagnosis
sections.summary: The process of identifying a disease or condition by examining a patient; also the conclusion reached as a result of that examination.

senses.definition: the process of identifying a disease, illness or condition through examination and tests
examples: The doctor provided a diagnosis of mild asthma and recommended a course of treatment.

senses.definition: the conclusion or opinion reached after careful examination of a problem
examples: The engineer's diagnosis of the fault helped the team fix the problem within hours.

answers.answer: After several tests, the specialist gave her a diagnosis and explained the treatment options.
She took the diagnosis to the pharmacy and collected the tablets she needed from the shelf.
He showed great diagnosis in finding the error in the complicated financial spreadsheet.
The diagnosis was very comfortable and all the patients felt well rested after their stay.

sections.question: examination
sections.summary: A careful and thorough inspection of a patient's body to assess their health; also a formal test of knowledge or ability.

senses.definition: a careful inspection of a patient by a doctor to assess their health
examples: After a thorough physical examination, the doctor concluded that the patient was in excellent health.

senses.definition: a formal test of someone's knowledge or skills, especially at school or university
examples: Students must pass a final examination before receiving their medical licence.

answers.answer: The doctor performed a careful examination of the patient's throat and chest before making a diagnosis.
She took her examination to the pharmacy to collect the medicine she had been told to take.
He showed great examination in identifying the fault in the complex computer system quickly.
The examination was very comfortable and guests were given a warm welcome on arrival.

sections.question: healthcare
sections.summary: The organised system of medical services and treatment provided to maintain or improve people's health.

senses.definition: the system of medical services provided to prevent, treat and manage illness and preserve wellbeing
examples: The government pledged to invest an additional five billion pounds in healthcare over the next decade.

answers.answer: Access to affordable healthcare is considered a basic right in many countries around the world.
She showed great healthcare in looking after her younger brother throughout the school holidays.
He wore his healthcare to the hospital appointment and felt much better immediately afterwards.
The healthcare was very tasty and the nurses enjoyed it thoroughly during their lunch break.

sections.question: immune system
sections.summary: The complex network of cells, tissues and organs in the body that work together to defend it against harmful bacteria, viruses and other foreign substances.

senses.definition: the network of cells and biological processes that protect the body from disease and infection
examples: A healthy diet and regular sleep help to keep your immune system strong and effective.

answers.answer: Regular exercise and good nutrition can significantly strengthen your immune system.
She showed great immune system in resisting the temptation to check her phone during the exam.
He bought some immune system from the pharmacy to help him recover from the cold more quickly.
The immune system was very comfortable and all the patients felt safe and secure inside.

sections.question: medication
sections.summary: A drug or medicine used to treat or prevent a disease or medical condition.

senses.definition: a drug or medicine used to treat or prevent a disease or medical condition
examples: The doctor prescribed medication to help control her blood pressure over the long term.

answers.answer: He takes daily medication to manage his diabetes and must never miss a dose.
She showed great medication in caring for the elderly residents at the local care home.
He wore his medication to the hospital and felt much more comfortable straight away.
The medication was so heavy that the nurse needed a colleague's help to carry it to the ward.

sections.question: nutrition
sections.summary: The process of taking in and using food for growth, health and energy; also the study of nutrients and how they affect the body.

senses.definition: the process of eating and absorbing the right foods to maintain good health
examples: Good nutrition is essential for children's healthy development, especially in the early years.

senses.definition: the science that studies food, diet and how nutrients affect the body
examples: She studied nutrition at university before becoming a registered dietitian.

answers.answer: Poor nutrition during childhood can have a lasting impact on a person's physical and mental health.
She showed great nutrition at the school sports day and won three gold medals overall.
He had a long nutrition with the school nurse about his plans for the summer term.
The nutrition was very comfortable and all the patients thoroughly enjoyed their time there.

sections.question: prescription
sections.summary: A written instruction from a doctor telling a pharmacist to supply a particular medicine to a patient; also a recommended course of action.

senses.definition: a written instruction from a doctor authorising a patient to receive a specific medicine from a pharmacist
examples: The doctor wrote a prescription for antibiotics after confirming the patient had a bacterial infection.

senses.definition: a recommended course of action to solve a problem
examples: Her prescription for success was simple: hard work, focus and constant learning.

answers.answer: She took the prescription to the pharmacy and collected her medication within ten minutes.
He showed the prescription to the museum attendant and was given free entry to the exhibition.
She prescription her patients to rest for at least a week before returning to full-time work.
The prescription was very comfortable and offered a wonderful view of the hospital garden.

sections.question: recovery
sections.summary: The process of becoming well again after an illness, injury or operation; also the process of regaining something that was lost.

senses.definition: the process of returning to a normal state of health after an illness, injury or operation
examples: Her recovery after the operation was faster than expected, and she left hospital within two days.

senses.definition: the process of regaining something that was lost or taken
examples: The economic recovery following the crisis took several years to take hold fully.

answers.answer: The doctor advised plenty of rest to support a full recovery after the knee operation.
She showed great recovery in finishing all the project reports well before the submission deadline.
He put his recovery in a bag and handed it carefully to the doctor at the follow-up appointment.
The recovery was very tasty and all the patients enjoyed it greatly during their stay on the ward.

sections.question: vaccination
sections.summary: The process of injecting a substance into the body to protect against a specific disease by stimulating the immune system.

senses.definition: the act of giving someone a vaccine to protect them against a disease by stimulating their immune system
examples: Doctors recommend annual vaccination against influenza, especially for elderly people.

answers.answer: The school arranged vaccination against measles for all students in the first year.
She showed great vaccination in protecting her team from criticism during the difficult project.
He wore his vaccination on his sleeve to show the border officials when he arrived at the airport.
The vaccination was very comfortable and the patients felt well-rested throughout their stay.
